meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review writing", "check documentation style", "audit interface copy", or "apply writing guidelines".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审阅文稿与界面文案，统一风格规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要核对文字是否符合既定写作规范
copy.tagline_en: Review copy and docs to ensure consistent style
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to check text against writing guidelines

howto.what: Claude 会读取你指定的文件或目录，对照内置写作规则（标题大小写、禁用词、被动语态、代码格式、标点等）逐项检查，产出一份按文件分组、带 `file:line` 行号的简洁审查清单。
howto.when: 当你说「审查写作」「检查文档风格」「审核界面文案」等要求时触发，再给出要检查的文件或目录。

say.text: 审查 docs/ 目录下的文档，按写作指南逐条检查。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并按行号给出检查结果。

say.text: 检查这份 interface copy 的风格，列出违规项和行号。
say.note: Claude 会对照规则输出简洁的审查发现。

say.text: 按写作指南审阅 *.mdx，输出 file:line 违规清单。
say.note: 输出按文件分组的行号清单。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the files or patterns you provide, checks them against a detailed writing guidelines checklist, and outputs a terse per-file review using `file:line` format.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to review writing, check documentation style, audit interface copy, or similar, and provide files or patterns to check.

say_en.text: Review the docs/ directory against the writing guidelines, checking each rule.
say_en.note: Reads the files and returns a line-numbered findings list.

say_en.text: Check the style of this interface copy and list violations with line numbers.
say_en.note: Outputs a terse review against the rules.

say_en.text: Audit *.mdx files per the guidelines; output violations as file:line.
say_en.note: Outputs a line-numbered checklist by file.
